lines.en: label utadorm15:
I knock on Uta’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Uta 的门，等她来开。

lines.en: I have also decided against bringing my wallet with me tonight because, even though this is her room and not the maid cafe, I will be damned if I trust that girl.
lines.zh: 今晚我还决定不带钱包——因为即便这是她的房间而不是女仆咖啡厅，我也绝不会相信那个女孩。

lines.en: : Whooooo is it?
: Someone without any money. Let me in.
lines.zh: : 一个身无分文的人。让我进去。

lines.en: : Sorry, Sensei! Gotta pay the admission price if you wanna hang out with Uta after hours.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sensei！过了营业时间还想跟 Uta 玩，得付入场费哦。

lines.en: : I’ve never had to pay before.
lines.zh: : 我以前从来不用付钱。

lines.en: : Yeah, but now you’re attached. You payin’ or not?
lines.zh: : 是呀，可现在你上钩了。你到底付不付？

lines.en: : Joke’s on you. I’ve been attached since the beginning.
lines.zh: : 你失算了。我从一开始就已经上钩了。

lines.en: scene black
: Is this open?
lines.zh: : 这算是明抢吗？

lines.en: : Hey! That’s shoplifting, mister!
lines.zh: : 喂！那叫入店行窃，先生！

lines.en: I turn the handle and, as expected, the door isn’t locked.
lines.zh: 我转动门把手，果不其然，门没锁。

lines.en: Here’s hoping that a police report isn’t filed and that Uta takes it upon herself to frisk me and prevent me from “shoplifting” again in the future.
lines.zh: 但愿别有人去报警，也但愿 Uta 会主动来搜我的身，好防止我以后再“入店行窃”。

lines.en: scene utafacetime1
: Fine. I’ll let you off the hook this one time. No hidden fees tonight. But don’t expect me to be doin’ anything {i}extra{/i} for ya.
lines.zh: 好吧。这次我放过你。今晚没有隐藏费用。不过别指望我会为你做{i}额外{/i}的事哦。

lines.en: : You’re all talk. You wouldn’t have done anything extra even if I brought my wallet with me.
lines.zh: 你只会说大话。就算我带了钱包，你也不会做什么额外的事。

lines.en: scene utafacetime2
: Am I really so tempting that you had to start leaving your money at home before coming to say hi?
lines.zh: : 我真的有那么诱人吗，诱到你来打招呼之前得先把钱留在家里？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : That’s really sad, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那可真够惨的，Sensei。

lines.en: : I have a problem, okay?
lines.zh: : 我有病，行了吧？

lines.en: : Anyway, what are you up to? No Io tonight?
lines.zh: : 总之，你在忙什么？今晚没有 Io 吗？

lines.en: scene utafacetime3
: She’s over at the bathhouse doin’ some extra scrubbin’ or something.
lines.zh: : 她去澡堂那边加做些清洁之类的活了。

lines.en: : I was gonna go with her, but decided to stay home and check in with my parents instead.
lines.zh: : 我本来要跟她一起去的，不过决定留在家里跟我爸妈打个电话。

lines.en: : Are you telling me I missed an opportunity to formally introduce myself to your parents as your future husband?
lines.zh: : 你是说我错过了一个以你未来丈夫的身份正式向你父母自我介绍的机会？

lines.en: scene utafacetime4
: I’m sorry, darling. But you know how my parents get when we show off our love for one another while I'm on Facetime.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，亲爱的。不过你也知道，我在视频通话的时候秀恩爱，我爸妈会是什么反应。

lines.en: : It’s okay. We can show off our love for one another right now instead. They don’t have to watch.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我们可以现在就秀恩爱。他们不用看。

lines.en: : I’m sorry again, but I’m far too tired to allow that tonight. Even if all I’d have to do is lay there like a dead fish and let you go to town on me.
lines.zh: : 再说一次抱歉，不过今晚我实在太累了，没法让你得逞。哪怕我要做的只是像条死鱼一样躺在那儿任你摆布。

lines.en: : Man, I can’t wait for the day when you run out of excuses.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我真等不及你找不出借口的那一天。

lines.en: scene utafacetime5
: Hope you’re okay with waitin’ a while!
lines.zh: : 那你恐怕得等上一阵子喽！

lines.en: : I’m glad you showed up when ya did, though. If you’d have walked into the room while I was talkin’ to my mom, she would have flipped.
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴你来得正是时候。你要是在我跟妈妈通话的时候走进来，她非得炸了不可。

lines.en: : Because I’m a male or because I’m your teacher?
lines.zh: : 因为我是男的，还是因为我是你的老师？

lines.en: : Both of those things. And also that I’m not wearin’ pants.
lines.zh: : 这两样都算。还有因为我没穿裤子。

lines.en: : Basically, we’d both have a lot of explainin’ to do. And even after, they’d never give you their blessing and we wouldn’t be able to get married.
lines.zh: : 基本上，我们俩都有得解释了。而且就算解释完，他们也不会祝福我们，我们就没法结婚了。

lines.en: : To think our entire futures could have been destroyed if you came a few seconds earlier.
lines.zh: : 想想看，要是你早来几秒钟，我们的整个人生都可能被毁掉。

lines.en: : That’s what she said.
lines.zh: : 她也是这么说的。

lines.en: : Ooooh, nice one. Ten points to Uta for the glorious set up.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，漂亮。这个铺垫太妙了，给 Uta 加十分。

lines.en: : So, now that your parents are out of the way, do I get you all to myself?
lines.zh: : 那么，你爸妈那边的事搞定了，我能不能独占你一会儿？

lines.en: : For a little while! I’m still waitin’ on a call from my brother, too. But his hours are all wacky because of prison and stuff.
lines.zh: : 一小会儿！我还在等我哥的电话。不过因为坐牢什么的，他的时间很没谱。

lines.en: : Wait, yeah. You said something about that before, but I couldn’t tell if it was a joke or not.
lines.zh: : 等等，对啊。你之前提过这事，不过我分不清是玩笑还是真的。

lines.en: : Did you think I was joking about my grandpa’s cancer, too?
lines.zh: : 那你以为我爷爷得癌症也是开玩笑咯？

lines.en: : What kinda sick sense of humor do you think I have, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我的幽默感得扭曲到什么程度，Sensei？

lines.en: : I...have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道。

lines.en: : Why is your brother in jail, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你哥为什么在坐牢？

lines.en: scene utafacetime6
: Cause he’s an idiot.
lines.zh: : 因为他是个白痴。

lines.en: : And maybe sorta kinda tried to kill somebody.
lines.zh: : 而且大概、也许、差不多算是有过杀人的企图。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : Long story.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: : He’ll probably get out in a couple years since the person didn’t actually die, but he’s in pretty hot water right now.
lines.zh: : 因为那个人其实没死，他大概几年后就能出来，不过现在麻烦挺大的。

lines.en: : Is there...something I’m not understanding about your family? Because we already have one girl with Yakuza ties and-
lines.zh: : 是不是……关于你家有什么我没搞明白的地方？毕竟我们已经有一个跟黑道有牵扯的女孩了，而且——

lines.en: scene utafacetime7
: Oh, come on. Just because {i}one{/i} Ushibori has attempted murder doesn’t mean we’re {i}all{/i} gonna do it.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。就因为{i}一个{/i} Ushibori 家的人企图杀人，不代表我们{i}全{/i}家人都会去干。

lines.en: : My family’s pretty normal apart from him and the long line of debilitating diseases on my mom’s side.
lines.zh: : 除了他，还有我妈那边那一长串让人丧失劳动能力的病，我家其实挺正常的。

lines.en: : RIP grandpa.
lines.zh: : 愿爷爷安息。

lines.en: : I think you really underestimate how uncomfortable it can be talking to you at times like this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你真是严重低估了这种时候跟你聊天能有多别扭。

lines.en: scene utafacetime8
: Nothin’ wrong with sayin’ things how they are, Sensei. And it’s not really {i}my{/i} fault if ya get uncomfortable because of it.
lines.zh: : 实话实说没什么不对啊，Sensei。而且你要是因为这个觉得别扭，那也不是{i}我的{/i}错。

lines.en: : I think it’s more of a matter of just not knowing how to respond to certain things you say.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更像是不知道该怎么接你说的某些话。

lines.en: : Is somebody forcin’ you to respond? Cause you can always walk away.
lines.zh: : 有人逼你接话吗？你随时可以走啊。

lines.en: : But then I’d miss out on precious Uta time.
lines.zh: : 可那样我就会错过宝贵的 Uta 时间了。

lines.en: : Not to mention you’ve encountered the rare glasses-pajama Uta. This only happens once a week for a two to three hour period based on the availability of the rest of the Ushiboris.
lines.zh: : 更别提你还撞见了稀有的眼镜睡衣版 Uta。根据 Ushibori 家其他人的情况，这每周只会发生一次，持续两到三小时。

lines.en: : Well, I hope that the rest of the Ushiboris are not as lively or weird as you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我希望 Ushibori 家其他人不像你这么闹腾、这么古怪。

lines.en: : I think I prefer “bubbly and spunky.”
lines.zh: : 我觉得我更喜欢“活泼又元气”这种说法。

lines.en: : And I think I’d prefer not standing across from a beetle while talking to you. Move over.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我更希望跟你说话的时候别站在一只甲虫对面。让开点。

lines.en: : Okay! But you’ve gotta promise not to touch me or look down my shirt to sneak a peek at my girls.
lines.zh: : 好！不过你得保证不碰我，也不许从领口往下偷看我的两个宝贝。

lines.en: : Or {i}up{/i} my shirt to see my underwear.
lines.zh: : 也不许从下{i}往上{/i}掀开看我的内裤。

lines.en: : Basically, just don’t look at me and everything will be okay.
lines.zh: : 基本上，只要别看我就万事大吉了。

lines.en: : Impossible. Do you have any idea how cute you are?
lines.zh: : 不可能。你知道自己有多可爱吗？

lines.en: : Of course. Why else do you think I started charging people to see me?
lines.zh: : 当然知道。不然你以为我为什么开始收钱让人看我？

lines.en: : Because you’re actually a demon trapped inside the body of a suspiciously well-endowed freshman.
lines.zh: : 因为你其实是个被困在一个发育得好得可疑的高一女生身体里的恶魔。

lines.en: : Blah blah boobies blah blah.
lines.zh: : 吧啦吧啦奶子吧啦吧啦。

lines.en: : You’re lucky I’m goin’ through my rebellious phase or I wouldn’t let ya on the bed at all.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，我正处在叛逆期，不然我根本不会让你上床。

lines.en: scene black
Uta rolls over and drags her laptop to the end of the bed.
lines.zh: Uta 翻了个身，把笔记本电脑拖到床尾。

lines.en: I immediately attempt to bypass one of her conditions by glancing up her shirt to catch a glimpse of her underwear-
lines.zh: 我立刻试图绕过她的条件之一——从她衣服下摆往上瞄一眼内裤——

lines.en: But alas.
lines.zh: 可惜。

lines.en: I fail.
lines.zh: 我失败了。

lines.en: I’ll just use my imagination instead and position myself in a way that will allow me to achieve an erection without drawing too much attention to it and making her run away- a thing I’m pretty sure she’d do.
lines.zh: 那我就靠想象力好了，顺便摆个姿势，好让自己能勃起又不至于太引人注目把她吓跑——我敢肯定她会跑的。

lines.en: scene utafacetime9
: Did you see?
lines.zh: : 你看见了吗？

lines.en: : Unfortunately, no.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，没有。

lines.en: : Really? But I gave you such a good opportunity to.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可我给了你那么好的机会啊。

lines.en: : I will gladly accept a second opportunity if you’re offering.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意给第二次机会，我很乐意接受。

lines.en: : No can do, Sensei. I only expose my panties once per year and now you have to wait for a whole other trip around the sun to get another shot.
lines.zh: : 不行哦，Sensei。我一年只露一次内裤，现在你得再等地球绕太阳转一整圈才有下一次机会。

lines.en: : Do you get pleasure out of disappointing me or something?
lines.zh: : 你是从让我失望这件事里得到快感还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Maybe~
lines.zh: : 也许吧~

lines.en: : Do you get pleasure out of {i}being{/i} disappointed?
lines.zh: : 那你会从感到{i}失望{/i}这件事里得到快感吗？

lines.en: : No. It sucks.
lines.zh: : 不会。那糟透了。

lines.en: : Then why do you keep comin’ to see me if you know I’m all bark and no bite?
lines.zh: : 那既然你知道我只是光叫不咬，为什么还一直来看我？

lines.en: : Because all dogs will bite if they’re antagonized enough and your bite sounds incredibly appealing.
lines.zh: : 因为只要被激怒得够狠，狗都会咬人，而你的咬听起来格外诱人。

lines.en: scene utafacetime10
: You want me to {i}bite{/i} you now?
lines.zh: : 你想让我现在{i}咬{/i}你吗？

lines.en: : I was just using a popular expression, Sensei. But to think you want an innocent little girl like me to push you down and sink her teeth into your private parts is just flat out gross.
lines.zh: : 我只是用了个常用说法而已，Sensei。不过你居然想让我这么一个天真无邪的小女孩把你推倒、把牙齿咬进你的私处，这简直就是彻头彻尾的变态。

lines.en: : First off, I was also using an expression.
lines.zh: : 首先，我也只是在用个说法。

lines.en: : Second, why did you immediately assume {i}that{/i} is where I wanted to be bitten? That sounds horrible.
lines.zh: : 其次，你为什么立刻就认定我想被咬的地方是{i}那儿{/i}？听着太可怕了。

lines.en: : You’re the one who asked for it. All I’m doing is trying to uphold my chastity.
lines.zh: : 是你自己要求的。我所做的只是努力守住我的贞操。

lines.en: : It doesn’t seem like you’re trying very hard based on your no pants policy and seductively unbuttoned, oversized pajama top.
lines.zh: : 从你的“不穿裤子政策”和解开好几颗扣子、松松垮垮的加大码睡衣上衣来看，你守得似乎并不怎么努力。

lines.en: : Bein’ comfy ain’t a crime, Sensei. You’re the one who showed up here unannounced.
lines.zh: : 舒服又不犯法，Sensei。是你自己不请自来的。

lines.en: : So unless you think I’m tryin’ to seduce Io or something...
lines.zh: : 所以除非你觉得我在试图勾引 Io 什么的……

lines.en: : I like that image. Please continue describing it.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢这个画面。请继续描述。

lines.en: scene utafacetime11
: Why’s your posture gettin’ all weird all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你的姿势怎么突然变得怪怪的？

lines.en: : No reason. Please continue.
lines.zh: : 没什么原因。请继续。

lines.en: scene utafacetime12
: No thank you, Sensei. If I {i}was{/i} going to seduce Io, I wouldn’t risk ruining the surprise by telling you about it first.
lines.zh: : 不了谢谢，Sensei。如果我{i}真要{/i}勾引 Io，我才不会冒险先告诉你、把惊喜给毁了。

lines.en: : You two are close enough to stay in hotel rooms together so, for all I know, you could be wearin’ a wire and feedin’ this all over to her right now.
lines.zh: : 你们俩亲近到能一起住酒店，所以说不定你身上现在就带着窃听器，正把这一切实时传给她呢。

lines.en: : I give you full permission to search every inch of my body for said wire.
lines.zh: : 我完全允许你搜遍我身上每一寸地方，找那个窃听器。

lines.en: : But if I did that, Io would know that I rubbed my hands all over you and suddenly we’d have a big ole love triangle on our hands.
lines.zh: : 可如果我那么做，Io 就会知道我满手都是在你身上摸过的痕迹，然后我们突然就摊上一个大大的三角恋了。

lines.en: : Do you actually hate me or are you just the national grand master of deflection?
lines.zh: : 你是真的讨厌我，还是只是国家级的话题转移大师？

lines.en: scene utafacetime13
: It’s nothing personal, Sensei. If I actually thought you were creepy, I wouldn’t hang out with you like this.
lines.zh: : 这不是针对你，Sensei。如果我真觉得你恶心，我才不会像这样跟你混在一起。

lines.en: : I just think the back and forth stuff is really fun and that it wouldn’t be good to jump straight into anything lewd.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得这种一来一回很有意思，而且直接跳到什么色色的事并不好。

lines.en: : And you’re probably right about that. It’s just-
lines.zh: : 你大概是对的。只是——

lines.en: : That I’m such a tease that you can’t help but wanna pick me up and throw me around?
lines.zh: : 只是我太会撩了，你忍不住想把我抱起来扔来扔去？

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: scene utafacetime14
: How about I make you a punch card?
lines.zh: : 那我给你办张集点卡怎么样？

lines.en: : Six thousand visits to the maid cafe will earn you one kiss. Then six thousand more will let you cop a feel.
lines.zh: : 光顾女仆咖啡厅六千次，可以换一个吻。再六千次，可以让你摸一把。

lines.en: : These rates are somehow even worse than Nodoka points.
lines.zh: : 这汇率不知怎么比 Nodoka 点还离谱。

lines.en: scene utafacetime15
: Oh! What can we use those for? Because I earned like a thousand during the dorm war sleepover thingy and I don’t know what to do with ‘em.
lines.zh: : 哦！那些点能用来干什么？因为我在宿舍战争过夜那次好像攒了一千点，不知道该怎么花。

lines.en: : Collect enough and Nodoka will have sex with you.
lines.zh: : 攒够了 Nodoka 就会跟你上床。

lines.en: : Wow.
: Thinking of saving up?
lines.zh: : 打算攒起来？

lines.en: : No, I’m just surprised because I watched her give Sana a million of them at the bar and that can really only mean one thing.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是惊讶而已——因为我看着她在酒吧给了 Sana 一百万点，那只能说明一件事。

lines.en: : I am not even remotely surprised by this.
lines.zh: : 我对此一点也不意外。

lines.en: scene utafacetime16
: I wonder if she’ll use them.
lines.zh: : 你说她会用掉吗？

lines.en: : Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana？

lines.en: : Mhm. A million should be enough for the grand prize, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯。一百万点应该够换大奖了吧？

lines.en: : I think so...But this is Sana we’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我想是吧……不过我们说的可是 Sana。

lines.en: : So?
lines.zh: : 所以？
: 所以……

lines.en: : It’s {i}Sana.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那可是{i}Sana{/i}啊。

lines.en: : Do you think it would be weird if Sana liked girls?
lines.zh: : 如果 Sana 喜欢女生，你会觉得很怪吗？

lines.en: : I think it would be weird if Sana liked {i}anyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Sana 会喜欢{i}任何人{/i}才叫怪。

lines.en: scene utafacetime17
: You don’t think it would be hot?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得会很带感吗？

lines.en: : Of course I do. But that doesn’t change how weird it would be.
lines.zh: : 当然觉得。可那也改变不了它有多怪。

lines.en: : Hmmmmmmmmmm...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……

lines.en: : Why “Hmmmmmmmm?” Why are you being so sketchy about this?
lines.zh: : 为什么“嗯嗯嗯嗯？”你为什么对这事这么神神秘秘的？

lines.en: : I’m wearing a wire for Maya and trying to catch you admit that you want to have a threesome with Nodoka and Sana.
lines.zh: : 我替 Maya 戴着窃听器，正在设法让你承认你想跟 Nodoka 和 Sana 玩三人行。

lines.en: : Maya, if you are listening right now, this is correct.
lines.zh: : Maya，如果你现在正在听，那他说对了。

lines.en: : In fact, I welcome any and all threesomes. Bring it on.
lines.zh: : 事实上，任何三人行我都欢迎。放马过来。

lines.en: scene utafacetime18
: You’re a really bad boyfriend, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你还真是个糟糕的男朋友，Sensei。

lines.en: : Yeah, whatever. Can I have your Nodoka points?
lines.zh: : 是啦是啦。那你的 Nodoka 点能给我吗？

lines.en: : Can we trade them? Is that allowed?
lines.zh: : 我们能交换吗？那允许吗？

lines.en: : I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。

lines.en: scene utafacetime19
: Want me to just kiss her for you?
lines.zh: : 要不我替你去亲她？

lines.en: : I’d much rather redeem this reward on my own.
lines.zh: : 我更想自己兑换这个奖励。

lines.en: : But, in the event that you do redeem it yourself, I’d greatly appreciate it if I could be there for it.
lines.zh: : 不过万一你真的自己去兑换了，我会非常感激能让我在场观礼。

lines.en: scene utafacetime12
: I’m afraid that will be up to Nodoka, Sensei. This is entirely out of my hands.
lines.zh: : 那恐怕得由 Nodoka 说了算，Sensei。这完全不归我管。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and attempt to break free of Uta’s incessant teasing loop.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，试图从 Uta 无休止的撩拨循环里挣脱出来。

lines.en: I don’t know if it’s her intention to just keep me permanently half-mast but, if it is, she is very much succeeding.
lines.zh: 我不知道她是不是故意要让我永远半硬着，不过如果真是，她做得非常成功。

lines.en: A few minutes go by as she scrolls through her phone and I begin to wonder if I’ll have to leave once her brother calls.
lines.zh: 她刷着手机，几分钟过去了，我开始担心她哥打来电话之后我是不是就得走了。

lines.en: It’s one thing to stay around and joke with girls while they’re talking to their parents, but...
lines.zh: 在女孩跟父母通话的时候留在旁边开玩笑是一回事，可是……

lines.en: I’m not sure if I’m brave or...stupid enough to do something like that with a person who has literally attempted murder on the other line.
lines.zh: 我不确定自己是有胆量，还是……蠢到能对电话那头一个真的企图杀过人的人做那种事。

lines.en: : Uta?
lines.zh: : Uta？

lines.en: : Yeah?
: What exactly happened with your brother?
lines.zh: : 你哥到底出了什么事？

lines.en: : I told you it’s a long story.
lines.zh: : 我说了说来话长。

lines.en: : Do you not have time?
lines.zh: : 你是没时间吗？

lines.en: scene utafacetime13
: I have plenty of time.
lines.zh: : 时间多得是。

lines.en: : It’s just not something I really like talking about.
lines.zh: : 只是我不太喜欢聊这件事。

lines.en: : He didn’t...try to murder {i}you{/i}, did he?
lines.zh: : 他……该不会是想杀{i}你{/i}吧？

lines.en: scene utafacetime20
: Do you really think I’d be talking to him on the phone if he tried to murder me?
lines.zh: : 如果他真想杀我，你觉得我还会跟他通电话吗？

lines.en: : Good point.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: : It’s just my first time talking to someone with a relative in prison, so I can’t help but be a little curious.
lines.zh: : 只是这是我第一次跟有亲属在坐牢的人聊天，所以我忍不住有点好奇。

lines.en: scene utafacetime13
: You’re free to be curious about me or the rest of my family! Mom. Dad. Dead grandpa. You name it.
lines.zh: : 你尽管对我或者我家其他人好奇好了！妈妈。爸爸。死掉的爷爷。随你挑。

lines.en: : Let’s save the brother stuff for another time, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我哥的事还是留到下次吧。

lines.en: : I really don’t want to talk about your dead grandpa.
lines.zh: : 我可真不想聊你死掉的爷爷。

lines.en: : Really? Cause he was a super interesting guy. And a super awesome koto player before his hands stopped working.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？他可是个超有趣的人。而且在他手还能动之前，是个超厉害的古筝手。

lines.en: : Yeah, see, this is why I didn’t want to go down that route.
lines.zh: : 看吧，这就是为什么我不想走那条路。

lines.en: : Just tell me about your parents instead. That sounds easier.
lines.zh: : 那就聊聊你爸妈吧。听着简单点。

lines.en: scene utafacetime21
: You sure you don’t wanna keep flirting with me instead?
lines.zh: : 你确定不想继续跟我调情吗？

lines.en: : I’m trying a new strategy of getting to know you before getting to the lewd stuff.
lines.zh: : 我在尝试一个新策略——先了解你，再干色色的事。

lines.en: : Who are you and what have you done with Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你是谁，你把 Sensei 怎么了？

lines.en: : Oh, okay then. I’ll just go back to trying to make out with you.
lines.zh: : 哦，那好吧。那我就回去继续想办法跟你接吻。

lines.en: scene utafacetime22
: No no no no! It’s fine. I’m just messin’ with ya. I’d be happy to tell you more about my folks.
lines.zh: : 不不不不不！没事。我刚才是逗你的。我很乐意跟你多讲讲我爸妈。

lines.en: : Just gotta keep in mind that we’re country people and that it’s probably not as interesting of a story as anyone you’d talk to over here.
lines.zh: : 只是你要记住，我们是乡下人，这故事大概没你在这儿随便找个人聊的那么有意思。

lines.en: scene utafacetime23
: My parents have a pretty huge age gap between ‘em.
lines.zh: : 我爸妈之间的年龄差挺大的。

lines.en: : Kinda like if you actually started seein’ somebody in our class for real.
lines.zh: : 大概就相当于你真跟我们班里的谁认真交往起来的那种差距。

lines.en: : They never told me much about how they met or what things were like when they were little, but it seemed to me like they were always pretty happy when I was growin’ up.
lines.zh: : 他们从来没怎么跟我说过他们是怎么认识的，或者小时候是什么样，不过在我长大的过程中，他们看起来一直都挺幸福的。

lines.en: : And even though we were out in the woods, we weren’t livin’ off the land or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 而且虽然我们住在林子里，我们也不是靠种地过活的那种。

lines.en: : Our house was actually kinda big by comparison to a lot of the other ones in the area.
lines.zh: : 跟那一带很多房子比起来，我家其实算挺大的。

lines.en: : But since they both had full time jobs, my brother and I had to stay at home a lot. And he was the one who watched me most of the time.
lines.zh: : 不过因为他们俩都有全职工作，我和我哥大部分时间都得待在家里。而大多数时候是他看着我。

lines.en: scene utafacetime24
: Then a whole bunch of other stuff happened and I moved here.
lines.zh: : 然后发生了一大堆别的事，我就搬来这儿了。

lines.en: : Didn't you move here to take care of your grandfather?
lines.zh: : 你不是为了照顾你爷爷才搬来的吗？

lines.en: : Yup yup! Good ole grandpa Ushibori.
lines.zh: : 对对！好爷爷 Ushibori。

lines.en: : That isn’t “other stuff.” It's a pretty major detail.
lines.zh: : 那可不是“别的事”。那是相当重要的一个细节。

lines.en: : It is!
lines.zh: : 是呀！

lines.en: : But that’s not the only reason I came to Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 可那不是我来 Kumon-mi 的唯一原因。

lines.en: scene utafacetime25
: The “other stuff” meant other stuff.
lines.zh: : 那些“别的事”就是别的事。

lines.en: : It was never the intention for me to stay here and finish [high_school]- just like it was never the intention to have me be the only one around when gramps died.
lines.zh: : 让我留在这儿读完 [high_school]，从来就不是计划中的事——就像爷爷去世的时候，让我成为唯一守在身边的人，也从来不是计划中的事。

lines.en: : I came because my parents thought it would be good for me to get away for a little while.
lines.zh: : 我来，是因为我爸妈觉得让我离开一阵子对我有好处。

lines.en: : And they were already familiar with Io’s aunt from when me and Io would chat online.
lines.zh: : 而且他们早就跟 Io 的姑姑熟了，因为我和 Io 以前会在网上聊天。

lines.en: : What did you have to “get away” from, though?
lines.zh: : 可你要“逃离”的到底是什么？

lines.en: : That’s the same thing I asked them when they talked about me coming here.
lines.zh: : 他们跟我说要我来这儿的时候，我也是这么问的。

lines.en: : I didn’t like the idea at first. I thought it was hopeless and a waste of time.
lines.zh: : 我一开始不喜欢这个主意。我觉得那没希望，是浪费时间。

lines.en: : But then I thought about how lonely grandpa and Io were...and I decided it would be good to come here and be there for them.
lines.zh: : 可后来我想到爷爷和 Io 有多孤独……我就觉得来这儿陪着他们是件好事。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure if I agree with uprooting your entire life for the sake of-
lines.zh: : 我不太确定我是不是认同为了——

lines.en: I stop talking mid-sentence, though I’m not sure why.
lines.zh: 不过我话说到一半就停住了，虽然我自己也不知道为什么。

lines.en: I had a thought-
lines.zh: 我有一个念头——

lines.en: But the thought disappeared.
lines.zh: 可那个念头消失了。

lines.en: And it doesn’t return until Uta drags it back by its neck.
lines.zh: 直到 Uta 揪着它的脖子把它拖了回来，它才重新出现。

lines.en: scene utafacetime26
: It didn’t really matter what I wanted. I was going to wind up here one way or another.
lines.zh: : 我想要什么其实并不重要。不管怎样，我最后都会走到这儿。

lines.en: : Grandpa and Io were just the bright sides I grabbed hold of to help start over.
lines.zh: : 爷爷和 Io 只是我抓住的、帮我重新开始的光明面。

lines.en: : Course, I wound up losin’ one of those bright sides to the grim reaper, but now I’ve got a bunch of {i}new{/i} bright sides instead.
lines.zh: : 当然，其中一个光明面最后被死神收走了，不过现在我有了一大堆{i}新{/i}的光明面。

lines.en: : I haven’t been here long, but I love Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿待的时间不长，但我爱 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: : And I love my class.
lines.zh: : 我爱我的班级。

lines.en: : And I love yo-
lines.zh: : 而且我爱——

lines.en: : ...gurt.
: You love yogurt?
lines.zh: : 你爱酸奶？

lines.en: scene utafacetime27
: Did you think I was gonna say “you?”
lines.zh: : 你以为我要说“你”吗？

lines.en: : Did you {i}want{/i} me to think that? Because that’s definitely how it sounded.
lines.zh: : 你{i}想{/i}让我那么以为吗？因为听上去确实就是那个意思。

lines.en: scene utafacetime28
: Sensei! Why are you trying to get me to say I love you when you already have Maya? And Ami? And Ayane? And...everyone else?
lines.zh: : Sensei！你已经有 Maya 了，还有 Ami？还有 Ayane？还有……其他所有人了，为什么还要逼我说我爱你？

lines.en: : Because {i}you’re{/i} the one I want, Uta.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}你{/i}才是我想要的那个人，Uta。

lines.en: scene utafacetime29
: I was...
lines.zh: : 我刚……

lines.en: : Were we not doing our back and forth anymore?
lines.zh: : 我们不是还在玩一来一回吗？

lines.en: scene utafacetime30
: Oh!
: Uhh...yeah!
: I just...kinda forgot for a second and...my mind kinda wandered.
lines.zh: : 我只是……有点走神了，然后……脑子就飘走了。

lines.en: : Sorry...about that...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……那个……

lines.en: scene utafacetime31
This is...new.
lines.zh: 这……是新鲜事。

lines.en: : Soooooo, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那那那，呃……

lines.en: : Yeah. Some more stuff about my parents...
lines.zh: : 对。再多讲点我爸妈的事……

lines.en: : Let’s see...let’s see...
lines.zh: : 我想想……我想想……

lines.en: scene utafacetime32
: Ah! Onii-chan’s jail!
lines.zh: : 啊！哥哥的监狱来电话了！

lines.en: : Perfect timing!
lines.zh: : 时机正好！

lines.en: : This timing is horrible. It seemed like you were actually about to fall in love with me or something.
lines.zh: : 这时机糟透了。刚才看起来你好像真的要爱上我了什么的。

lines.en: scene utafacetime33
: I’m sorry, Sensei. But you and I are not meant to be. And even if the red string of fate is wrapped neatly around our fingers, the time will come where we must snap it and-
lines.zh: : 抱歉了，Sensei。可你和我注定无缘。就算命运的红线整整齐齐地缠在我们手指上，也总有一天我们必须把它扯断，然后——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Save your rejection for my next hundred confessions.
lines.zh: : 是啦是啦。把你的拒绝留给我接下来一百次表白吧。

lines.en: : I’ll leave you and your brother alone.
lines.zh: : 我就不打扰你和你哥了。

lines.en: scene utafacetime34
: Uhh...wait!
lines.zh: : 呃……等等！

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Do you...
scene utafacetime35
: Do you think that maybe you could spare some money for his commissary?...
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能不能匀点钱给他当生活费？……

lines.en: scene black
: Goodbye, Uta.
lines.zh: : 再见，Uta。

lines.en: : Noooo, wait! How will he be able to afford his ramen without your hard-earned money?
lines.zh: : 不——要，等等！没有你辛苦挣来的钱，他怎么买得起他的拉面？

lines.en: : Use some of the millions of yen I’ve given you.
lines.zh: : 用我给你的那几百万日元里的一些啊。

lines.en: : But that’s mine! I need it for Uta stuff!
lines.zh: : 可那是我的！我需要它买 Uta 的东西！

lines.en: : Goodnight, Uta.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Uta。

lines.en: : Sensei! Come baaaaaaaack!
lines.zh: : Sensei！回——来——啊！

lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
